_doc: Registry of every @ultrastable.* address named anywhere in the repo: how it is routed, where the owner reads it, and what is not yet true. Checked by foundation/brandcheck.py: an address in the repo that is missing here fails the check. Routing state was read from the Cloudflare Email Routing API for zone ultrastable.io on 2026-11-11. No mailbox address is stored here (destinations are named by provider only).
probe: Cloudflare API GET /zones/{zone}/email/routing/rules (needs Email Routing read); expect the rules named below enabled

addresses.route: Cloudflare Email Routing rule 'pilot inbox' (enabled), forward
addresses.used_for: public contact: pilots, partnerships, commercial licensing, security reports (interim), org profile

addresses.route: Cloudflare Email Routing rule 'hello@ultrastable.io to owner' (enabled), forward
none yet; mail is dropped (catch-all is disabled)
addresses.next: Add a forward rule to the same destination as pilot@. A session attempt on 2026-11-11 was refused by the permission check (account routing change); until a rule exists, SECURITY.md in every repo names pilot@.

addresses.route: outbound only: dashboard MAIL_FROM through the Email Sending binding, destination restricted to the owner address
addresses.read_at: n/a (the owner receives the digests and sign-in codes it sends)
addresses.used_for: owner dashboard sign-in codes, check failures, daily digest

addresses.route: outbound only: git identity of the outreach workflow; sender not registered, so outreach runs dry-run
addresses.used_for: funding and partner outreach once the gate allows live sends

addresses.route: none; named in the Google for Startups kit as a future sending-capable address
